run_vae_roundtrip: run the VAE roundtrip CLI to encode and decode an image through a pretrained VAE model
build_vae_model: build a VAE model from a pretrained checkpoint using AutoencoderKL or AutoencoderTiny with optional subfolder and variant
test_image_conversion: test converting a PIL image to an NHWC tensor and back to a PIL image
review_latent_encoding: review encoding an RGB image into latent space and decoding it back to reconstructed RGB pixels
summarize_image_concatenation: summarize concatenating two PIL images side by side or vertically into a single composite image
